dedupe_keys.name: saudi arabia electricity load monthly by region

description: Saudi Arabia Electricity Load Monthly by Region is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Arabia Electricity load in GW by region, recorded maximum, average and minimum load monthly 2009 - 2019. Data from Electricity and Cogeneration Regulatory Authority. The Electricity and Cogeneration Regulatory Authority (ECRA) website has changed to Water & Electricity Regulatory Authority (WERA). Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Electricity. Its keywords are Electricity, Peak Load. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
